verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a risk register: NIST risk scenarios can be added from a risk library for tracking, and Comply AI for Risk produces inherent risk scores, treatment, residual risk scores and justifications. Risks are also exposed as manageable objects through the MCP server. Missing for 10: evidence of risk owners, recurring risk review cycles, explicit linkage of risks to controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
